users-admin.title: Users
users-admin.adminRequired: Instance administrator access is required to manage users.
users-admin.description: Create and manage board users. Self-registration is disabled.
users-admin.oneTimeHint: Copy this link now. It is shown only once and is not retained here.
users-admin.tempPasswordHint: Leave blank to issue a one-time setup link.

missing-user-secrets-banner.title: Set your user secrets
missing-user-secrets-banner.description_one: {{count}} user secret you are responsible for has no value yet. Runs that require it will fail until you set your value.
missing-user-secrets-banner.description_other: {{count}} user secrets you are responsible for have no value yet. Runs that require them will fail until you set your value.

my-user-secrets-tab.intro: These are credentials only you provide. Each value is yours alone — used when you are the user responsible for a run — and is never shown back to anyone, including admins.
my-user-secrets-tab.missing_one: {{count}} required secret still needs your value.
my-user-secrets-tab.missing_other: {{count}} required secrets still need your value.
my-user-secrets-tab.empty: No user secrets are defined for this organization yet. An admin defines which credentials each member supplies.

proposals-tab.emptyMessage: When an agent proposes a secret or an access binding, it shows up here for review.
proposals-tab.intro: Agents propose credentials and access bindings; you approve or reject them here. Proposed values are never shown — only a fingerprint and length.

set-my-user-secret-dialog.description: This value is yours only. It is used when you are the user responsible for a run that needs <1>{{key}}</1>.
set-my-user-secret-dialog.externalRefHint: Points at your own credential in the configured provider. Myrmidon stores the reference, not the value.
set-my-user-secret-dialog.valueHint: Stored encrypted. Never shown back to anyone, including admins.

user-secret-definitions-tab.intro: Define credentials that <1>each member supplies for themselves</1>. You set the shape here; every user enters their own value under My secrets. Coverage shows how many members have set a value — never the values themselves.
user-secret-definitions-tab.empty: No user secret definitions yet. Create one to require each member to supply their own credential.
user-secret-definitions-tab.dialogDescription: Members supply their own value for this credential. No value is entered here.
user-secret-definitions-tab.name: Name
user-secret-definitions-tab.keyHint: Stable identifier referenced by env bindings.
user-secret-definitions-tab.usageGuidancePlaceholder: Tell members how to create their token, required scopes, etc.
user-secret-definitions-tab.removeDescription: This removes the definition <1>{{key}}</1> for the whole company. Existing member values become unreferenced. This cannot be undone.

proposal-review.rotateDescription: The proposed value becomes the next version of the existing secret. Agents bound at @latest pick it up on their next wake.
proposal-review.createDescription: The value is created as the proposing agent recorded it. Re-folder or rename it before it lands.
proposal-review.bindingDescription: Grant the target agent access to this secret. This runs with your permissions.
proposal-review.targetInactive: The target secret is {{status}}; approving this proposal will fail until it is active again.
proposal-review.rotateHint: The live name and key stay fixed. Verify the fingerprint below against the value you expect before rotating.
proposal-review.name: Name
proposal-review.alsoApprove: Also approve the proposed secret <1>{{name}}</1> and create it in the same step. The binding can’t land without it.
proposal-review.rejectDescription: The reason is sent back to <1></1>. Dependent bindings are rejected too.
proposal-review.noPermission: You don’t have permission to approve this.

import-from-vault-dialog.selectedNotVisible: {{selected}} selected · {{hidden}} not visible with current search
import-from-vault-dialog.iamMissing: The AWS principal behind this vault is missing secretsmanager:ListSecrets. Update IAM and try again.
import-from-vault-dialog.noSecretsVisible: No secrets visible to this vault.
import-from-vault-dialog.nothingSelected: No secrets selected. Go back to pick remote secrets to import.

secrets.modeExternalWritable: Myrmidon resolves this provider reference and can write new values to it via Update value.
secrets.modeExternalReadonly: Myrmidon resolves this provider reference but does not rotate the provider value.

secrets.blockNoExternal: {{provider}} does not support linked external references.
secrets.blockNotConfigured: Deployment default {{provider}} is not configured. Select a ready provider vault or configure the deployment default.
secrets.healthUsingSelectedVault: Using selected provider vault. Deployment default {{provider}} is not configured.
secrets.vaultDraftOnly: This provider vault is saved as draft metadata only.
secrets.vaultHealthFailed: This provider vault health check failed.
secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.selectOrganization: Select an organization to manage secrets.
secrets.empty: No secrets yet. Create a shared organization secret or one that each user supplies.
secrets.emptyFolder: No secrets in this folder yet.
secrets.tipResolvedUser: Last resolved: user values resolve per member
secrets.userOwnsValue: Each user provides and owns their own value
secrets.createDescription: Choose who provides the value. Shared fields keep their values when you switch modes.
secrets.providerHint: Organization stores one shared value. Each user lets every member supply their own value under My secrets.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.creatingIn: Creating in {{path}} — remove the chip to type a different path.
secrets.externalHint: Existing provider secrets are resolve-only in Myrmidon. Rotate the value in the provider, then update this reference only if the path, ARN, or version changes.
secrets.userHint: Every member supplies their own value under My secrets. Agents resolve the responsible user's value at runtime.
secrets.usageGuidancePlaceholder: Tell members how to create their token, required scopes, etc.
secrets.keyHintLocked: Stable env binding key. Cannot be changed.
secrets.keyHintUser: Env-style key used by user-secret bindings.
secrets.keyHintShared: Shared secret keys keep lowercase dash normalization.
secrets.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this secret used for? (no values)
secrets.managedNote: Myrmidon-managed secrets are created in the selected provider and future rotations write a new provider version through Myrmidon.
secrets.vaultDialogDescription: Save only non-sensitive routing metadata. Credentials stay in the runtime environment or provider identity.
secrets.draftProviderNote: This provider can save draft routing metadata, but runtime writes and resolution stay disabled until the provider module is implemented and reviewed.
secrets.rotateDescManaged: Creates a new provider-backed version. Consumers pinned to latest pick up the new value on the next run.
secrets.rotateDescReference: Creates a new Myrmidon metadata version that points at an existing provider secret. Myrmidon does not write a new provider value.
secrets.rotateDescExternal: Writes a new version of the referenced provider secret. The new value becomes current for every consumer of that secret, in and outside Myrmidon.
secrets.rotateDefaultNote: Rotating with the deployment default preserves current fallback behavior.
secrets.rotateReferenceNote: Rotate the actual value in the provider before changing this Myrmidon reference.
secrets.deleteSecretDescription: Permanently removes <1>{{name}}</1>. Active bindings will fail until you remap them.
secrets.deleteUserSecretDescription: Permanently removes <1>{{name}}</1> for the whole organization. Existing member values become unreferenced and active bindings must be remapped.
secrets.removeVaultAws: This does not delete the remote AWS Secrets Manager vault, secrets, or any AWS data.
secrets.removeVaultOther: This does not delete any remote provider data.
secrets.removeVaultTail: Secrets using this vault will lose the vault association until you assign another one.
secrets.howToTitle: Use secrets by binding them to runtime environment variables.
secrets.howToStep1: Create or link a secret here, then open an agent's Environment variables or a project's Env field. Add the env key the process expects, for example <1>GH_TOKEN</1>, choose <2>Secret</2>, and select the stored secret version.
secrets.howToStep2: Myrmidon resolves the value server-side when the run starts and injects it as that env var. Project env applies to every task in the project and overrides agent env on matching keys.
secrets.configureAwsTitle: Configure an AWS provider vault to enable remote import
secrets.noVaults: No organization-specific vaults yet. Secrets can still use the deployment default provider settings.
secrets.refreshSecretsTitle: Refresh AWS metadata and import existing secrets
secrets.backupAck: I understand backup and restore require both the database metadata and the local encrypted master key file.
secrets.awsDiscoveryHint: Uses the current draft routing fields to inspect AWS Secrets Manager metadata. Values are not read.
secrets.enterRegion: Enter an AWS region before discovery.
secrets.noCandidates: No AWS vault metadata candidates found. Manual entry is still available.
secrets.discoveryDeniedMessage: Discovery needs secretsmanager:ListSecrets in the selected region for the Myrmidon server runtime/provider credential path.
secrets.discoverySafeAlternative: If you already know the exact AWS Secrets Manager ARN, paste/link that ARN instead of using discovery. Exact-resource DescribeSecret and runtime read permissions are still required.
secrets.createDeniedTitle: AWS secret creation needs CreateSecret permission
secrets.noStablePrefix: No stable namespace or prefix detected
secrets.noValueStored: No value is stored on this admin row. Each member manages their own value under My secrets.
secrets.coverageNote_one: Coverage is counts only across {{count}} member. Secret values are never shown here.
secrets.coverageNote_other: Coverage is counts only across {{count}} members. Secret values are never shown here.
secrets.userUsageHint: Bind runtime environment variables to this user-provided secret by choosing <1>User secret</1> and selecting <2>{{key}}</2>.
secrets.userEventsHint: Access events are recorded on each member's stored value when runtime resolution occurs.
secrets.envVarExists: {{name}} already has an env var named {{key}}.
secrets.agentAccessCompany: Add here to inject this secret as an environment variable at run start. API-access grants (fetched on demand, no env var) are managed from each agent's Secret access settings and shown below.
secrets.agentAccessUser: These agents resolve the responsible user's value as an environment variable at run start.
secrets.agentsUnavailable: Agent list unavailable. Manage access from each agent's configuration instead.
secrets.envKeyRules: Env keys use letters, digits, and underscores, and cannot start with a digit.
secrets.noBindings: No active bindings. Add this secret in agent, project, environment, or plugin config to start using it.
secrets.noEvents: No access events recorded yet. Each runtime resolution writes a redacted entry here.
